description_zh: 调用CreateVpcGatewayEndpoint接口创建网关终端节点
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-vpc-gateway-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-bp1gsk7h12ew7oegk0000 --service-name com.aliyun.cn-hangzhou.oss --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVpcGatewayEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC for which you want to create the gateway endpoint.

The VPC must be in the same region as the gateway endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
要创建网关终端节点的VPC ID。

该VPC必须与网关终端节点在同一个地域
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The service name of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
The access policy for the cloud service.

For more information about the syntax and structure of access policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html.


This parameter is required if the selected endpoint service supports access policies.
This parameter must be empty if the selected endpoint service does not support access policies.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448920.html operation to check whether an endpoint service supports access policies. A value of true for SupportPolicy indicates that access policies are supported
parameters.help_zh:
云服务的访问策略。

关于访问策略的语法和结构，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html。


当选择的终端节点服务支持设置访问策略时，该字段必填；
当选择的终端节点服务不支持设置访问策略时，该字段必须为空。
终端节点服务是否支持设置访问策略，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448920.html接口获取，SupportPolicy为true表明支持，否则不支持
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en:
The name of the gateway endpoint.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
网关终端节点的名称。

名称的长度在1~128个字符之间
parameters.name: endpoint_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the gateway endpoint.

The description must be 1 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
网关终端节点的描述信息。

描述信息的长度在1~255个字符之间
parameters.name: endpoint_description

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without creating the gateway endpoint. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned. The check items include whether the AccessKey pair is valid, whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user has the required authorization, and whether the required parameters are specified.

false (default): sends a Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the gateway endpoint is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建网关终端节点。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并创建网关终端节点
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the gateway endpoint belongs
parameters.help_zh: 网关终端节点所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the gateway endpoint that you want to create.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的网关终端节点的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the gateway endpoint was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 网关终端节点的创建时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

EndpointId.description_en: The endpoint instance ID of the gateway endpoint instance

EndpointName.description_en: The name of the gateway endpoint

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the gateway endpoint belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 网关终端节点所属的资源组ID

ServiceName.description_en: The service name of the endpoint service
